mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.5%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates broad-based demand contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both RSAFS and HOUST decline but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of such cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), the Federal Reserve's expected policy tightening causes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS) consistently signals robust consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS growth is positive, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 95.0, it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO < 95.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates severe supply-side shock that depresses equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The negative return signal fails when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline but S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In strong consumer demand regimes (RSAFS growth > 1.5% YoY), elevated revenue expectations drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth > 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
